_comment: Curated input for scripts/generate-hook-reference.py, which renders docs/HOOKS.md. Add a purpose for every script registered in hooks/hooks.json and a role for every other file in hooks/; the generator's --check fails otherwise.
wiring: **Claude Code** reads `hooks/hooks.json` from the plugin root; commands use `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`.
**Codex** loads the same manifest from the plugin package. `scripts/install-codex.sh` rewrites the paths and routes each command through `hooks/codex-hook-adapter.sh`.
**Cursor** uses `hooks/cursor-hooks.json`, generated from `hooks/hooks.json` by `scripts/generate-cursor-hooks.py`; each command runs through `hooks/cursor-hook-bridge.sh`.

Matchers name tools from every host: `Bash` (Claude) and `exec_command` (Codex) are shell calls; `apply_patch` is the Codex edit tool; `CallMcpTool`/`MCP` are MCP calls; `Task|Subagent|Agent` are subagent spawns.

Enforcement hooks first check that the project is activated (`.silver-bullet.json` and `silver-bullet.md` at the project root, see `hooks/lib/sb-project-gate.sh`); outside an SB project they exit 0, apart from the missing-`jq` case below.

Unexpected errors fail open: almost every hook installs an `ERR` trap that exits 0 (some print a notice or a no-op payload first). Exceptions: `phase-archive.sh` denies the `phases clear` it guards when archiving fails, and `rfl-policy-c-gate.sh` has no `ERR` trap, so an unexpected error surfaces as a non-blocking hook error.

A missing `jq` does not fail open everywhere. `session-start` warns that enforcement is disabled and most hooks exit 0, but `completion-audit.sh`, `dev-cycle-check.sh`, `forbidden-skill-check.sh`, `planning-file-guard.sh`, `uat-gate.sh` and `workflow-chain-guard.sh` block in an initiated project (`hooks/lib/jq-gate.sh`), and `completion-audit.sh` also blocks commit, push, PR, release and deploy commands outside one.

event_notes.PreToolUse: Before a tool runs; a hook can deny the call.
event_notes.PostToolUse: After a tool runs; a hook can report, record state, or ask the agent to stop.
event_notes.Stop: When the agent tries to end its turn; a hook can block the stop.
event_notes.UserPromptSubmit: Before each user prompt is processed; hooks add context or record the requested route.

purposes.agent-delegation-guard.sh: While an `/sb:agent-*` delegation is active, blocks parent-session edits on Claude and Codex and advises on Cursor.
purposes.agentmemory-gate.sh: Opt-in (`recommended_tools.agentmemory`): requires a recent agentmemory capture/retrieval before substantive work.
purposes.alumnium-gate.sh: Opt-in (`recommended_tools.alumnium`): checks that the Alumnium MCP server is wired before browser/visual work.
purposes.ci-status-check.sh: Checks the latest GitHub Actions run for the branch. Pre: blocks `git push`, `gh pr create/merge` and `gh release create` while CI failed or was cancelled. Post: warns after `git commit`. CI-fix commits and the `ci-red-override` flag bypass it.
purposes.completion-audit.sh: Two-tier delivery gate. Commits, pushes and commit plumbing need `skills.required_planning`; `gh pr create/merge`, deploy commands and `gh release create` need `skills.required_deploy` plus the release gates (live matrices, quality-gate markers, RC matrix, green CI on the release commit).
purposes.compliance-status.sh: Prints workflow progress (flow N/M, or recorded-skill count) after every tool call. Informational only.
purposes.compression-marker-guard.sh: Blocks writes whose content contains LeanCTX compression markers (pasted `ctx_read` output).
purposes.context-mode-gate.sh: Opt-in (`recommended_tools.context_mode`): checks Context Mode install and MCP/hook wiring.
purposes.context-mode-read-deny.sh: Opt-in (`recommended_tools.context_mode`): denies Read/Grep on files larger than `read_deny_bytes`.
purposes.debug-dump.sh: Debug only: when the `debug-dump` flag file exists in the runtime state dir, appends each PreToolUse payload to `hook-dump.jsonl` there. Never blocks.
purposes.dependency-skill-check.sh: Compatibility gate for dependency-skill invocations. Does not block SB-absorbed namespaces; forbidden execution modes are handled by `forbidden-skill-check.sh`.
purposes.dev-cycle-check.sh: Planning-floor gate: blocks source edits and shell writes until workflow admission or the `required_planning` skills are recorded. Also blocks edits under the host plugin cache and direct writes to SB state files.
purposes.flow-advance.sh: Advances the autonomous orchestrator flow queue after a skill or tracked command completes.
purposes.forbidden-skill-check.sh: Blocks forbidden skills: the built-in list (`executing-plans`, `subagent-driven-development`) plus `skills.forbidden`.
purposes.graphify-gate.sh: Opt-in (`recommended_tools.graphify`): requires a recent Graphify query before substantive work.
purposes.industry-tooling-hint.sh: Optional reminders about industry tooling for shell commands; active only when `hooks.industry_tooling.enabled` is true.
purposes.instruction-file-guard.sh: Blocks creating a brand-new root `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` during initialization; existing files may be reconciled in place.
purposes.instruction-ledger-gate.sh: Maintains the nested per-session instruction ledger; at Stop, blocks while ledger items remain open.
purposes.leanctx-gate.sh: Opt-in (`recommended_tools.leanctx`): checks LeanCTX install, wiring and usage freshness.
purposes.live-publish-evidence-gate.sh: Requires fetched live-page evidence before a site publish is claimed LIVE (Stop) and before `git push` to main for site work.
purposes.orchestrator-directive-guard.sh: Orchestrator parent mode: blocks edits, shell commands and Task spawns until the skill named by the pending directive has been invoked.
purposes.outcomes-check.sh: Tracks the per-prompt outcome checklist; at Stop, blocks while outcomes are incomplete.
purposes.phase-archive.sh: Archives `.planning/phases/` directories before a `phases clear` command runs. Fails closed: if archiving fails, the clear is denied.
purposes.phase-lock-claim.sh: Claims the `.planning/phases/<NNN>/` lock (via `.planning/scripts/phase-lock.sh`) before a session edits a phase's files.
purposes.phase-lock-heartbeat.sh: Refreshes heartbeats for the phase locks this session holds (throttled to once per 5 minutes per phase).
purposes.phase-lock-release.sh: Releases this session's phase locks at Stop/SubagentStop. Never blocks.
purposes.planning-file-guard.sh: Blocks direct edits to SB-managed planning artifacts (`.planning/ROADMAP.md`, `STATE.md`, phase `PLAN.md`/`SUMMARY.md`, ...); they change only through the owning SB skill.
purposes.pr-traceability.sh: After `gh pr create`, appends the spec traceability block to the PR body and records the PR URL in `SPEC.md`.
purposes.prompt-reminder.sh: Injects a compact compliance reminder (missing skills, active workflow position, opted-in tool notes) before each prompt.
purposes.record-agentmemory-usage.sh: Records successful agentmemory retrievals (CLI or MCP) for the opt-in agentmemory gate.
purposes.record-graphify-query.sh: Records successful Graphify queries for the opt-in Graphify gate.
purposes.record-leanctx-usage.sh: Records LeanCTX CLI/MCP usage for the opt-in LeanCTX gate.
purposes.record-recommended-mcp.sh: Records agentmemory/Graphify MCP tool calls for the opt-in gates.
purposes.record-requested-skill.sh: Records the SB route requested in the user prompt (for example `/sb:feature`) in the state file.
purposes.record-site-session.sh: Records `site/**` edits and site-intent prompts so the site session gates know a site session is active.
purposes.record-site-visual-evidence.sh: Records browser screenshot paths as site visual evidence.
purposes.record-skill.sh: Records completed skill invocations (host Skill tool, or `silver-bullet invoke-skill` receipts on Codex) in the state file.
purposes.record-token-compression-usage.sh: Records token-compression CLI usage (RTK) for the opt-in usage-freshness gate.
purposes.review-fix-ladder-guard.sh: Enforces the review-fix-ladder state machine while a ladder session is active.
purposes.rfl-policy-c-gate.sh: While a review-fix-ladder run is active (`.planning/rfl-*/LADDER-STATUS.json`), denies advancing when Policy C or sibling artifacts are missing.
purposes.rfl-quota-retry-due.sh: Activates review-fix-ladder quota-retry jobs whose retry time has arrived. No-op when none are scheduled.
purposes.roadmap-freshness.sh: Blocks `git commit` when a phase `SUMMARY.md` is staged but its `ROADMAP.md` checkbox is not ticked.
purposes.rtk-gate.sh: Opt-in (`recommended_tools.rtk`): checks RTK install, version and host hook wiring (it does not rewrite commands itself).
purposes.semantic-compress.sh: After phase skills, assembles a ranked context summary for the current phase goal (`semantic_compression` config).
purposes.session-log-init.sh: When the session mode is written, creates the `docs/sessions/` log skeleton; in autonomous mode starts the timeout sentinel.
purposes.session-start: Injects the core rules, resets branch- and worktree-scoped state, clears the trivial marker and stale gate files, and probes prerequisites (warns when `jq` is missing).
purposes.site-chrome-guard.sh: Blocks inline `<nav>`/`<footer>` in site HTML (canonical fragments live in `site/_chrome/`) and unmarked font edits in `site/tokens.css`.
purposes.site-preview-preflight.sh: Before `site/**` edits, checks that the local site preview server is healthy.
purposes.site-regression-gate.sh: Runs the site regression tests at Stop and before `git push` when `site/**` was touched in the session.
purposes.site-visual-evidence-gate.sh: At Stop, requires 1280px visual evidence for active site sessions.
purposes.spec-floor-check.sh: Spec floor: blocks `sb:plan` without a minimum viable `SPEC.md`; advisory for `sb:fast`.
purposes.spec-session-record.sh: Captures spec version and Jira ID from `.planning/SPEC.md` for `pr-traceability.sh`.
purposes.stack-compression-coordinator.sh: Five-tool stack coordinator: routes Read/Grep/shell/WebFetch/MCP surfaces to their owning tool and blocks double compression.
purposes.stack-compression-lifecycle.sh: On compaction, records the LeanCTX lifecycle phase after the agentmemory snapshot.
purposes.stop-check.sh: Stop/SubagentStop gate: blocks a task-complete declaration while `required_planning` skills are missing, and enforces doc-scheme finalization when `docs/doc-scheme.md` exists.
purposes.subagent-start.sh: Injects the worker banner and tool requirements into subagent sessions.
purposes.subagent-stop-enforcement.sh: Tracks Task worker spawns and returns; at Stop, blocks a parent session whose workers ran but `sb:completion-audit` is not recorded.
purposes.timeout-check.sh: Autonomous mode only: warns on wall-clock timeout and on 30/60/100 tool calls without a recorded skill.
purposes.token-compression-tools-gate.sh: Opt-in: requires recent RTK usage before substantive commits.
purposes.trivial-file-clear.sh: Deletes the legacy trivial-session marker after any file write.
purposes.trivial-file-guard.sh: Blocks agents from creating the legacy trivial marker; small changes go through `/sb:fast`.
purposes.uat-gate.sh: Blocks `sb:release` and milestone completion when `UAT.md` is missing, failing or stale against the spec version.
purposes.v-loop-rollup-gate.sh: At Stop, blocks when active site-session V-loops lack evidence.
purposes.workflow-chain-guard.sh: Inside a composed workflow (`.planning/workflows/<id>.md`), blocks implementation edits until the pre-execution chain is recorded.

unregistered.hooks.json: The registration manifest itself (Claude Code plugin format; Codex reads the same file from the plugin package).
unregistered.cursor-hooks.json: Cursor hook manifest, generated from `hooks.json` by `scripts/generate-cursor-hooks.py` (Cursor event names, `${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}` paths, every hook wrapped by `cursor-hook-bridge.sh`). Do not edit by hand.
unregistered.cursor-hook-bridge.sh: Cursor bridge: `cursor-hook-bridge.sh <cursorEvent> <hook>` translates a Cursor hook payload into the SB hook protocol, runs the hook with a subprocess timeout and maps the result back.
unregistered.codex-hook-adapter.sh: Codex adapter: `scripts/install-codex.sh` rewrites installed hook commands to run through it (`codex-hook-adapter.sh <event> <hook>`); it buffers stdin/stdout and applies a subprocess timeout (`SB_CODEX_HOOK_SUBPROC_TIMEOUT`).
unregistered.kay-project-hook-bridge.sh: Project-level hook bridge for the Kay (Codex-compatible) runtime; the live-test harness registers it in `~/.kay/config.toml` (`tests/live/lib/kay-codex-isolation.sh`).
unregistered.agent-delegation-progress-surface.sh: Library, not a hook: sourced by `agent-delegation-guard.sh` to render bounded, redacted delegation progress (8 lines / 2 KB).
unregistered.run-hook.cmd: Windows/Unix polyglot wrapper: `run-hook.cmd <script> [args]` finds Git for Windows bash (or bash on PATH) and runs the hook.
unregistered.core-rules.md: Core enforcement rules that `session-start` injects into context.
unregistered.core-rules.sha256: Integrity pin for `core-rules.md`, checked by `hooks/lib/core-rules-integrity.sh` before injection.

lib_footer: `hooks/lib/completion-audit/` holds the modules `completion-audit.sh` sources (command classification, planning tier, deploy tier, change class, gate runners, state helpers). `hooks/lib/tool-input/` holds the Python helpers `tool-input.sh` calls to parse tool payloads (command strings, write targets, patch paths, RTK unwrapping).
